name: Resistance to Negative Energy (Monster)
body:
The creature gains resistance to the effects of negative energy (such as that delivered by inflict spells, channeled energy, some undead, or exposure to negative energy creatures).

Benefit: The creature gains resistance 5 to any damage-dealing/healing negative energy effect.

Special: This feat can be taken twice. The second time it is taken, the creature’s resistance rises to 10.
